summary.text: Apply for a cremation permit, then book a slot online or at the Mandai Crematorium Service Counter.

details.heading: Funeral director help
details.body: Your funeral director can help you with this.

steps.name: Apply for a permit
steps.text: Apply for a permit to cremate through the NEA ePortal. Submit only one application.

steps.name: Book the cremation slot
steps.text: Book online using the NEA ePortal, or visit the Mandai Crematorium Service Counter during opening hours.
